mediaWork.focusOrTheme: In-depth legal investigations of wrongful convictions and systemic failures in the U.S. criminal justice system.
mediaWork.summaryNotes: Investigative podcast hosted by attorneys Rabia Chaudry, Susan Simpson, and Colin Miller. Spanning 24+ seasons (starting with Adnan Syed, Joey Watkins, Shaurn Thomas, Willie Veasy, Terrance Lewis, Chester Holman III, Ronnie Long, Dennis Perry, and more), the series examines trials, police files, and newly uncovered evidence; relaunched in 2025 as "Undisclosed: Toward Justice."
